I first came across this product while shopping for the Ilia skin tint (which I absolutely love!). I used the tester on the top of my hand, and when I got home, I kept noticing how much softer my hand felt after using this moisturizer. I kept eyeing it and wanting to try it for the longest time, so I finally caved when I found a coupon that worked on this product. For the price, I expected much more. I'm honestly glad I didn't spend the money on the larger bottle. avis.titre: Light, Layerable, and So Easy to Love
avis.texte: I received both the ILIA Barrier Build Skin Protectant Cream and The Base Face Milk Essence & Lightweight Moisturizer for free from PINCHme in exchange for my honest review‚ and I've been pleasantly surprised by how seamlessly they fit into my routine. The Face Milk is light and milky‚ perfect for daytime use when I want hydration without any heaviness. On its own, it gives my skin a smooth, fresh finish that feels like my skin, just more balanced. At night or when I need a little extra moisture, I'll layer it with the Barrier Build cream and wake up to calm, soft skin. Together, they create a flexible combo that works for my combo skin without overwhelming it. No strong scent, no irritation, and no greasy residue. Just simple, effective hydration I can build up or keep minimal depending on the day. Definitely a win for anyone who wants skincare that adapts with you.

avis.titre: Best Thing Yet I Have Added to My Nightly Skin Regimen
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin, it sometimes reacts negatively to new products, especially when it comes to moisturizer. I was pleased at the results of using this product. Maybe this is the type of moisturizer that I should be using and the technique of applying it as well. First, it's light weight, non-greasy, and easily absorbs into my skin. A white cream liquid that you pat into your face. (This is a method I had not thought about before and maybe that is a better way of applying some beauty products.) I put this on after washing, applying serum, allowing the serum to set a minute, then patting on Ilia Base Face Milk Essence. Since I have started using this (and will continue to do so), my complexion is alive, supple, skin tone is more even, no redness to speak of (which has been a problem for me in the cheeks), the overall look of my face has improved and that is the only thing I have changed in recent weeks is adding The Base Face to my nightly routine. I'm keeping it! I love it!
